title: Average Price Allocation
description: Split one block order's fills across accounts at one average price, in exact ISO 4217 minor units. Returns the total, the 8-decimal average, each account's amount before and after the rounding residual, the signed residual and where it went, and the identity check. The rounding basis and residual rule are declared conventions of this tool, not a regulatory or fairness rule. Calculation check, not investment, legal or regulatory advice.

currency.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code. Sets the minor unit (JPY 0; BHD, KWD, OMR, TND, JOD 3; most codes 2). Unknown codes are refused.

side.description: buy labels amounts as cost, sell as proceeds. The arithmetic is the same.

fills.description: Executed fills of one block order, at most 5,000.

price_per_share.description: Positive decimal string, at most 15 integer digits and 8 decimals, e.g. "10.50".

currency.description: Optional per-fill currency; refused unless it equals the top-level currency.

allocations.description: Accounts receiving the fills, at most 500. Shares must sum exactly to the filled quantity.

account.description: Pseudonymous account id, 1 to 64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -. Duplicates are refused.

shares.description: Whole shares allocated to the account.

amount_basis.description: Default unrounded_average. rounded_average_dp rounds the average half-up to average_price_dp first.

average_price_dp.description: Required with rounded_average_dp; refused with unrounded_average.

residual_handling.description: Default assign_largest under unrounded_average; required with no default under rounded_average_dp.

output_example.note: Average-price allocation in exact integer minor units (ISO 4217 minor unit for the declared currency). total_minor = half-up(sum of quantity x price). average_price = sum(quantity x price) / sum(quantity), 8 decimals half-up. Per account: half-up(shares x average) under unrounded_average, or half-up(shares x average rounded half-up to average_price_dp) under rounded_average_dp. residual_minor = total_minor - sum of account amounts; assign_largest adds it to the account with the most shares (ties to the first declared), report_unallocated leaves it unallocated. Identity: sum of final account amounts + unallocated residual = total_minor. The rounding basis and the residual rule are declared conventions of this tool, not a regulatory or fairness rule. Calculation check, not investment, legal or regulatory advice.
